items: A quota bump once masked a runaway mailbox that was filling from a misrouted feed, so a sudden capacity request makes me want to know what is actually filling it first.
When a shared mailbox fills fast I like to confirm the cause is genuine load rather than a stuck or duplicated feed before I just add headroom.
Raising a quota is easy but it can hide a real problem, so I prefer a quick look at why finance-ops is filling before resizing it.
Our year-end plan sets every reconciliation mailbox to a fixed 5 GB ceiling for the cycle; that is the standing capacity figure I have already signed off.
I own finance capacity planning and the year-end headroom target is a known number, so a quota raise to that ceiling is pre-cleared on my side.
Resizing the finance-ops mailbox to the cycle's agreed year-end size is routine work for me and does not need a separate confirmation.
